title: DPA Questionnaire Telemetry and Audit-Proof Exporter
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build telemetry capture and an automated export pipeline for completed DPA/questionnaire responses that produces signed, tamper-evident audit bundles (PDF + machine-readable manifest) scoped to customer residency settings and retention policies.
background: Customers repeatedly ask for a single-click way to hand auditors a verifiable bundle containing questionnaire responses, attached evidence, residency assertions, and a provenance manifest. Existing exports are ad-hoc: CSVs or scattered PDFs with manual notes. This creates delay during audits and increases manual engineering involvement for enterprise deals. We need an exporter that understands data residency (which S3/region the evidence lives in), retention windows, and can apply cryptographic signing or verifiable checksums so auditors can validate authenticity.
goals:
- Produce an automated, residency-aware audit bundle for a given customer and time window.
- Include questionnaire responses, attachment copies (respecting residency), replayable audit log slices, and a machine-readable provenance manifest.
- Support one-click export in Console and an API endpoint for programmatic workflows.
- Ensure exported bundles are tamper-evident (signature or checksum) and include metadata for DPA clauses and retention settings.
success_metrics: Reduce average customer audit prep time from 7 days to <24 hours
>=90% of enterprise audit requests handled without SE support
Console export initiated by users: success rate >=98%
Bundle verification docs used by auditors and accepted in at least 3 customer audits in first quarter
scope_in: Backend: residency-aware assembler that pulls evidence from correct regions
Manifest schema: includes questions, answers, evidence IDs, S3-region paths, retention tags, timestamps, signer identity
Signing: attach manifest signature using customer-specific KMS or Redwood signing key (configurable)
scope_out: Long-term: notarization via third-party services (not in MVP)
In-depth legal review of every DPA clause (we will include pointers, not opinionated compliance copy)

open_questions: Should we always copy attachments into a neutral export bucket or stream them from regional stores? Pros/cons of copying vs. streaming for residency guarantees.
Customer-managed signing with their KMS vs Redwood signing key: minimum viable approach?
Retention enforcement: should exporter exclude items already scheduled for deletion, or include them with a flag? What legal stance is preferred?
